description: Group of entities domains and/or categories. Categorizing elements for ease of display and finding

elementid.description: unique ID of the category for reference purposes

name.description: Unique (over the whole schema) name of the category

categorytype.description: Type of elements the category is used to group.

description.description: Reason, building aspect for this category.

parentid.description: ElementId of parent of current category, null for root categories

additionalProps.description: additional properties (aka user defined properties udp) are  any properties of an this element  added by the current modeller. They serve as an extension to the predfefined element properties.

CategoryId.description: typed ID unique over all categories in this schema

CategoryType.description: Catetory-objecttype, of which aspect a category groups elements together
